name: north-zapier-integration
description: Zapier Platform integration for North -- lets a Zap trigger a North flow and poll North's flow runs. 2026-10-06, built to the credential point (needs a Zapier developer account + `zapier login` + `zapier push` to actually go live -- same shape as every other connector in this project needing a provider's client_id/secret before it can be tested).
